title: What Did Jesus Do in Hell for 3 Days? Psalm 16:10
description:
What did Jesus do in hell for three days? Here is what the Bible says.

"For thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; neither wilt thou suffer thine Holy One to see corruption." (Psalm 16:10, KJV)

People tell a lot of stories about the three days. This Short stays with three verses: Psalm 16:10, Colossians 2:15 and Revelation 1:18. The grave did not keep him, and he holds the keys.
